title: Lakeside Struggle Free Retreat
description:
Take it easy at this unique and tranquil getaway.  Gorgeous Family Retreat located on Old Hickory Lake close to Downtown Nashville.  Watch the sunrise on your private deck overlooking lake with great fishing, swimming, skiing and bird watching.  This place overlooks a natural bird habitat.  Enjoy swimming and fishing directly behind the house.  Beautiful sunsets most days.

The space
Please note there are a number of stairs to climb to enter the property.  Bedroom 3 is a queen pullout couch off to the side of the  living room area.  Please see photos.

Guest access
This is a gorgeous property built above the carport of an adjoining property.  Your space is a separate space 2 traditional bedrooms with a third sleeping space in the living room area off to the side.

Other things to note
There are a number of stairs leading up to the property.
